about: Hand translation of the web-platform-tests webmcp/ subtests into traces for the Lean model's oracle (Main.lean). Scored by tools/wpt-score.cjs; method and caveats in wpt/README.md.

format.trace: ops exactly as the oracle reads them; `setup` (if present) reproduces state left by earlier subtests in the same file and is run first, its outcomes unchecked
format.checks: `at` indexes the trace (not setup); `want` is what the WPT assertion requires: {outcome} exact oracle outcome string, {names} tool names in order, {count}, or {tool, field} with {equals}|{isNull}|{notNull}|{json}|{path, equals}
format.setup: a check with `setup: true` is incidental (an awaited call the test needs to succeed) and does not by itself make a subtest count as expressible
format.proxy: the model value substituted for a WPT value it cannot express, and why the substitution reaches the same spec steps
format.extra: a second trace for the same subtest, when one tool cannot show two things at once
format.expectDisagree: the recorded classification of a check known to disagree; the scorer flags any disagreement without one, and any classified check that now agrees
